name: glassys
description: Self-hosted chat face for local coding-agent CLIs
author: KN <hello@kn990x.dev>

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @glassys/protocol --filter @glassys/adapter-contract --filter @glassys/adapter-cursor --filter @glassys/adapter-claude --filter @glassys/adapter-opencode --filter @glassys/adapter-gemini --filter @glassys/adapter-codex --filter @glassys/adapter-acp run build && concurrently -n pkgs,gateway,web -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @glassys/protocol --filter @glassys/adapter-contract --filter @glassys/adapter-cursor --filter @glassys/adapter-claude --filter @glassys/adapter-opencode --filter @glassys/adapter-gemini --filter @glassys/adapter-codex --filter @glassys/adapter-acp --parallel run build:watch" "pnpm --filter @glassys/gateway run dev" "pnpm --filter @glassys/web run dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @glassys/protocol --filter @glassys/adapter-contract run build && pnpm --filter @glassys/protocol --filter @glassys/adapter-contract --filter @glassys/adapter-cursor --filter @glassys/adapter-claude --filter @glassys/adapter-opencode --filter @glassys/adapter-gemini --filter @glassys/adapter-codex --filter @glassys/adapter-acp --filter @glassys/gateway --filter @glassys/web run test && node --test scripts/host-service.test.mjs
